ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with a low frequency of high-intensity (white) focal regions, estimated macro-level ratio of 0.03:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pigmentation across the entire visible surface. Distinct high-contrast white focal points are distributed as follows: a cluster of three small spots on the proximal-left lobe, a single bright vertical mark on the medial-left lobe, and several isolated white pixels on the distal-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees forming a deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel amplitude for individual peaks varies between 8 and 22 pixels, with higher density on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly rounded lateral edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast pixel rings ranging from 4 to 12 pixels in diameter; notable concentrations are visible in the central-medial region and the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of four distinct, nearly vertical high-contrast linear streaks on the lower-left lobe and two slanted linear disruptions on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of circular rosette scars and linear rake-like marks across both lobes; no significant macro-anatomical amputations detected on the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tip of the left lobe shows a higher density of micro-serrations and pixel-level erosion compared to the relatively smoother right tip.
